e2e.description: E2E-only PostSync probes; enabled by values-kind.yaml in the kind e2e environment, never in production.

enabled.description: Deploy the P2P pull-test probe Job and its RBAC.

probeNamespace.description: Namespace the probe Job runs in.

probeImage.description: Shell + curl image for the probe; talks to the Kubernetes API and Spegel metrics endpoints.

pullImage.description: Image whose two-node pull proves P2P serving; must live on a registry Spegel mirrors (docker.io).

spegel.description: Values passed to the upstream spegel chart (oci://ghcr.io/spegel-org/helm-charts/spegel).

global.description: Helm-internal global values coalesced into every subchart namespace.

tag.description: Image tag; defaults to the chart appVersion when empty.

digest.description: Pin the image by digest; takes precedence over the tag when set, e.g. "sha256:0123...". Leave unset to inherit the upstream chart's digest-pinned image.

nameOverride.description: Override the name of the chart.

namespaceOverride.description: Override the namespace the spegel resources are installed into.

name.description: Service account name; generated from the release name when empty.

daemonsetAnnotations.description: Annotations to add to the DaemonSet.

podAnnotations.description: Annotations to add to the pod.

revisionHistoryLimit.description: Number of old DaemonSet revisions to retain for rollback.

securityContext.description: Container security context. The upstream default enables readOnlyRootFilesystem.

service.description: Service exposure. Ports must not collide with Kubespray host services (kube-apiserver 6443, etcd 2379/2380, kubelet 10250, ...) and nodePort must stay inside kube_apiserver_node_port_range (default 30000-32767).

nodeIp.description: Override the NODE_IP environment variable; defaults to status.hostIP.

port.description: In-pod registry listener port (also the NodePort Service's cluster port).

nodePort.description: NodePort that containerd mirror configs target (http://<nodeIP>:<nodePort>).

port.description: libp2p DHT listener port (TCP and UDP/QUIC).
Port exposing the cleanup probe used by the post-delete hook.

resources.description: Resource requests and limits. GOMEMLIMIT is derived from limits.memory by the chart.

nodeSelector.description: Node selector for pod assignment; must cover the entire cluster.

updateStrategy.description: DaemonSet update strategy; rolling one node at a time keeps a mirror candidate per image in the DHT.

tolerations.description: Tolerations so the DaemonSet also runs on Kubespray control-plane nodes.

commonLabels.description: Labels applied to all rendered resources.

clusterDomain.description: Cluster domain for the DNS bootstrap service; Kubespray default is cluster.local.

serviceMonitor.description: Prometheus Operator ServiceMonitor for the metrics Service.

labels.description: ServiceMonitor discovery labels, e.g. metrics.uplink.io/monitor: prometheus.

relabelings.description: Relabeling rules applied to target metadata.

metricRelabelings.description: Relabeling rules applied to samples before ingestion.

networkPolicy.description: Limits libp2p router traffic to Spegel peers; registry and metrics listeners stay open.

priorityClassName.description: Priority class for the pod; system-node-critical matches node-critical agents (CNI/CRI plugins).

basicAuthSecretName.description: Name of a secret with basic auth credentials protecting the registry.

spegel.description: Spegel application settings (the upstream chart's own `spegel` block).

mirroredRegistries.description: Registries for which mirror configuration is written. Must be non-empty on Kubespray: an empty list writes only a _default/hosts.toml catch-all, which per-registry hosts.toml files rendered by Kubespray take precedence over.

additionalMirrorTargets.description: Fallback registries (e.g. a pull-through cache) appended after the P2P mesh and existing certs.d mirrors.

prependExisting.description: Prepend Spegel in front of existing certs.d host entries instead of replacing them; required while Kubespray manages containerd_registries_mirrors.

mirrorResolveRetries.description: Maximum number of mirrors to attempt per request.

mirrorResolveTimeout.description: Maximum duration spent finding a mirror (Go duration string).

containerdSock.description: Path to the containerd socket; Kubespray default /run/containerd/containerd.sock.

containerdNamespace.description: containerd namespace where images are stored; CRI uses k8s.io.

containerdRegistryConfigPath.description: Path to containerd mirror configuration; Kubespray default /etc/containerd/certs.d.

containerdContentPath.description: Path to the containerd content store, mounted read-only; Kubespray default /var/lib/containerd/io.containerd.content.v1.content.

containerdMirrorAdd.description: Let the init container write the certs.d mirror configuration on each node.

resolveTags.description: Resolve tags to digests so cached manifests can be reused across nodes.

registryFilters.description: Regular expressions filtering which tags/registries are resolved; empty resolves all.

persistence.description: Host persistence for the libp2p host key so nodes keep stable DHT identities across restarts.

hostPath.description: Path on the host mounted into the container.

debugWebEnabled.description: Enable the instance stats page at /debug/web on the metrics port; used by the verification runbook.

verticalPodAutoscaler.description: Optional Vertical Pod Autoscaler for the DaemonSet; not enabled in this deployment.

enabled.description: Add a /livez liveness probe to the registry listener.

extraVolumes.description: Additional volumes appended to the DaemonSet pod.

extraInitContainers.description: Additional init containers run before Spegel's configuration init container.
